verdict.rationale: GlitchTip's own CLI can create releases and record deployments against them (glitchtip-cli releases new / deploys new), which supports the release side of the story. Its general Sentry API compatibility claim does not specifically evidence commit association or suspect-commit attribution. missing for 10: associating commits with releases, suspect-commit identification on issues, evidence that issues display the release they first appeared in, independent or hands-on corroboration.
